acceptedQualifications: Exact authenticated unauthorized-member HTTP status and protected-detail suppression were not fully established. Member management/connection denial UI is narrower evidence, not a captured HTTP403 proof.
Hosted cross-business registration, refresh, placement modification and publication denial remain unverified. Local and restricted-role database evidence do not substitute.
Hosted forged paid-policy HTTP denial remains unverified; local service and restricted database rejection passed.

S10 hosted token refresh/expiry and established-connection disconnect, provider revocation and reconnection qualifications remain outstanding. An additional credentials_saved audit is consistent with existing refresh infrastructure, not complete lifecycle proof.
Provider pagination beyond the first returned page and YouTube manual-refresh preservation were not hosted-demonstrated.

Elapsed-time retention deletion was not hosted-demonstrated. Cleanup requires a running application; an outage beyond the 29-day margin is not a demonstrated 30-day deletion guarantee. This remains a Production retention-readiness qualification.
Published connected-source library projection is bounded to 100 placements per business; pagination beyond that is not implemented.

Eligibility is limited to publicly embeddable Vimeo and public, processed, embeddable, non-live YouTube without reported region/age restrictions. Provider restrictions may change and native playback may independently deny.
Acrux placement access cannot protect direct provider URLs. External protected paid/rental delivery, uniform playback controls and native Mirror enforcement are not supported.

Original S10 specific sampled-video identity and historical dirty-checkout test qualifications remain unchanged. S11 identified current selected videos; this does not retroactively identify the original S10 sample.
Original local preview used mocked HTTP and blocked external network. Corrected local browser preview was unreachable, not passed; subsequent hosted re-inspection provides the three UI results.
